paper_id: Wu et al. - 2015 - Human Mobility Enhances Global Positioning Accuracy for Mobile Phone Localization
title: Human Mobility Enhances Global Positioning Accuracy for Mobile Phone Localization
motivation: GPS误差(1-20m)限制了位置服务应用，现有增强系统依赖固定基础设施
problem_framing: 将手机惯性传感的局部轨迹与GPS全局坐标对齐来提升精度
key_insight: 死计算的局部轨迹结构比GPS测量更接近真实轨迹,可据此校正GPS
method_signature: FSM步态检测+学习步长估计+陀螺仪方向+ Horn坐标变换
evaluation_criteria: GPS平均误差减少30%,从5-10m降至约3m,能耗可忽略
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当GPS原始测量严重偏离真实位置时,GloCal精度也受限
evidence_for_taste: realizing accurate dead reckoning is non-trivial
we shy away them by using only short trajectories
can be gracefully tolerated since a scaling factor
the difficulty still remains since that the stride lengths vary
thinking_moves: 用相对坐标系统完全规避绝对方向依赖,避开罗盘噪声
短轨迹策略消除累积误差而非尝试补偿
将perception问题重构为coordinate transformation问题
将步态积分的累积误差转化为步数×步长避免了直接积分
承认死计算误差存在但用坐标变换的缩放因子容忍之
extraction_notes: paper完整但缺少具体会议名称,DOI信息缺失
